# Lanna Bloom
> Chiang Mai flower and gift delivery with secure online checkout. Order bouquets, flowers, plush toys, and balloons for local delivery in Chiang Mai and selected Thailand destinations.

Lanna Bloom is an online flower and gift delivery service (not a multi-seller marketplace). Primary market: Chiang Mai, Thailand. Bouquet delivery also available in Phuket, Hua Hin, Koh Samui, Krabi & Ao Nang, and Pattaya. Site is bilingual (English and Thai). Checkout uses Stripe. Same-day delivery may be available depending on order time, stock, and capacity.

Contact: support@lannabloom.shop · WhatsApp/phone +66 80 331 3431 · 90 Wichayanon Rd, Chang Moi, Mueang Chiang Mai 50300, Thailand. DBD Verified online business.
